verdict.rationale: Rootly's schedule docs explicitly cover building on-call schedules with rotations, layers, overrides, restrictions, and previews, so who is on call at any time follows how the team works. Round robin is documented in escalation policies, which spreads pages across responders. Schedules can also be migrated from other tools. Missing for 10: any evidence of time-zone handling in schedules, round-robin as a schedule-level coverage mode rather than an escalation-policy feature, and independent or hands-on corroboration of scheduling depth.
